root.label: Viet Tan report on Vietnamese transnational repression cases

events.label: Viet Tan report on Vietnamese transnational repression cases

slots.name: documented cases
slots.sentence: Viet Tan, a pro-democracy group composed of members of the Vietnamese diaspora, published a report in September that documented 20 cases where Vietnamese authorities pursued critics and activists outside its own borders.

slots.name: terrorist designation status
slots.sentence: The Vietnamese government has designated Viet Tan as a "terrorist group," a charge the group denies.
